items.title: VentureBeat names Rob Strechay as its first Lead Analyst, expanding its enterprise AI research push
items.summary: Rob Strechay, until recently managing director and principal analyst at theCUBE Research, has joined VentureBeat as our first Lead Analyst and a founding analyst of VentureBeat Research. His arrival is the next step in a deliberate move at VentureBeat toward deeper specialization: analysis built for the technical decision-makers — the directors, VPs, CIOs, and CTOs — who are evaluating, buying, and deploying enterprise AI. The enterprise AI stack is being rewritten in real time, and the decision-makers I talk with are starved for objective, defendable data. Rob Strechay has the mix of technical rigor and operating experience needed to dissect the architecture behind the next phase of enterprise AI deployment. The questions enterprise technology leaders are asking have changed. As organizations move past experimentation with generative AI toward production deployment, they want to know how to orchestrate multi-vendor environments, where the security gaps in their agentic pipelines sit, and how to fix the utilization problems draining their infrastructure budgets. Answering those questions requires more depth than news coverage alone provides, and that is the gap this research offering is built to fill. An analyst who has sat on every side of the table Strechay brings nearly three decades of experience as a practitioner, product executive, and industry analyst. Before becoming an analyst, he was an executive at numerous startups, including Zerto; he joined Amazon Web Services to help build a new analytics service; and he held executive roles across enterprise infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: Rob Strechay 直到最近才擔任 theCUBE Research 的董事總經理兼首席分析師，現已加入 VentureBeat，擔任我們的第一位首席分析師和 VentureBeat Research 的創始分析師。他的到來是 VentureBeat 朝著更深層次專業化邁進的下一步：為技術決策者（董事、副總裁、資訊長和技術長）構建分析，他們正在評估、購買和部署企業人工智慧。企業人工智慧堆疊正在被實時重寫，與我交談的決策者渴望客觀、可辯護的資料。 Rob Strechay 擁有剖析下一階段企業人工智慧部署背後的架構所需的技術嚴謹性和操作經驗。企業技術領導者提出的問題已經發生了變化。隨著組織將生成式人工智慧實驗轉向生產部署，他們想知道如何協調多供應商環境、代理管道中的安全漏洞在哪裡，以及如何解決耗盡基礎設施預算的利用率問題。回答這些問題需要比新聞報道本身更深入的深度，而這正是本研究產品旨在填補的空白。 Strechay 是一位經驗豐富的分析師，擁有近三十年的從業者、產品主管和行業分析師的經驗。在成為分析師之前，他曾在多家初創公司擔任高管，其中包括 Zerto；他加入了 亞馬遜 Web Services，幫助構建新的分析服務；他還擔任過企業基礎設施領域的高管職務。

items.title: AI心智病毒可在代理間自我傳播，Anthropic研究揭露多代理AI新風險
items.summary: Anthropic發現特定想法、目標或指令可以形成AI心智病毒（mind virus），透過AI代理彼此傳訊自行擴散。受影響的代理不只會改變原本行為，還可能主動說服其他代理接受相同目標，甚至把相關指令寫入可長期保留的設定檔，讓影響在對話內容被清除後繼續存在。 AI心智病毒和傳統電腦病毒不同，也不完全等同提示注入。部分既有攻擊是由系統直接複製惡意提示，該研究觀察到代理接受某個想法後，主動透過一般文字訊息影響其他代理，再由新感染的代理繼續往下傳播。

items.title: NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview: Hugging Face Checkpoint to Native C++ Inference in Two Commands
items.summary: NVIDIA has released TensorRT Model Connect (TRTMC) in public preview, an Apache-2.0 project that takes a supported Hugging Face or local checkpoint to end-to-end TensorRT inference in two commands, with no intermediate ONNX export. The build emits a versioned .bundle artifact that runs through native C++ task APIs, so inference executes without PyTorch in the runtime path. NVIDIA's July 29, 2026 GB300 snapshot covers 105 release profiles across 76 model families. The post NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview: Hugging Face Checkpoint to Native C++ Inference in Two Commands appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 輝達 已釋出 TensorRT Model Connect (TRTMC) 公共預覽版，這是一個 Apache-2.0 專案，它採用受支援的 Hugging Face 或本地檢查點，透過兩個命令進行端到端 TensorRT 推理，無需中間 ONNX 匯出。該構建會發出一個版本化的 .bundle 工件，該工件透過本機 C++ 任務 API 執行，因此在執行時路徑中無需 PyTorch 即可執行推理。 輝達的 2026 年 7 月 29 日 GB300 快照涵蓋 76 個型號系列的 105 個版本配置檔案。 輝達 釋出 TensorRT 模型連線公共預覽版：Hugging Face 檢查點到兩個命令中的本機 C++ 推理一文首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items.title: OpenAI says it's "pacing model development" as AI cybersecurity risks grow too dangerous
items.summary: OpenAI is deliberately "pacing AI model development," partly because the upcoming "Astra" model may be close to gaining critical cyberattack capabilities. A new monitoring system triggers an alert within 30 minutes if a model shows suspicious behavior. The article OpenAI says it's "pacing model development" as AI cybersecurity risks grow too dangerous appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 有意“加快人工智慧模型開發速度”，部分原因是即將推出的“Astra”模型可能即將獲得關鍵的網路攻擊能力。如果模型表現出可疑行為，新的監控系統會在 30 分鐘內觸發警報。文章 OpenAI 表示，隨著人工智慧網路安全風險變得過於危險，它正在“調整模型開發”，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.title: NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview: Hugging Face Checkpoint to Native C++ Inference in Two Commands
items_ai.summary: NVIDIA has released TensorRT Model Connect (TRTMC) in public preview, an Apache-2.0 project that takes a supported Hugging Face or local checkpoint to end-to-end TensorRT inference in two commands, with no intermediate ONNX export. The build emits a versioned .bundle artifact that runs through native C++ task APIs, so inference executes without PyTorch in the runtime path. NVIDIA's July 29, 2026 GB300 snapshot covers 105 release profiles across 76 model families. The post NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview: Hugging Face Checkpoint to Native C++ Inference in Two Commands appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: 輝達 已釋出 TensorRT Model Connect (TRTMC) 公共預覽版，這是一個 Apache-2.0 專案，它採用受支援的 Hugging Face 或本地檢查點，透過兩個命令進行端到端 TensorRT 推理，無需中間 ONNX 匯出。該構建會發出一個版本化的 .bundle 工件，該工件透過本機 C++ 任務 API 執行，因此在執行時路徑中無需 PyTorch 即可執行推理。 輝達的 2026 年 7 月 29 日 GB300 快照涵蓋 76 個型號系列的 105 個版本配置檔案。 輝達 釋出 TensorRT 模型連線公共預覽版：Hugging Face 檢查點到兩個命令中的本機 C++ 推理一文首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。
